name: @chroni/desktop
description: Local-first learning execution agent with grounded document understanding, evidence-led planning, and ambient companion interaction.
author: Chroni contributors

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && pnpm run build:main && cross-env CHRONI_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.cjs .
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -s command-electron -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.build:goai: cross-env CHRONI_PET_ASSET_MODE=original pnpm run build && node ../../scripts/verify-goai-assets.mjs
scripts.store:screenshots: pnpm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/capture-store-listing.cjs
scripts.package: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:store: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && node ../../scripts/generate-store-assets.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-store-readiness.mjs --platform=windows --release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win appx --x64 --publish never && node ../../scripts/verify-store-artifact.mjs --platform=windows
scripts.package:mac:store: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:product-assets && node ../../scripts/generate-store-assets.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-store-readiness.mjs --platform=macos --release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac mas --universal --publish never && node ../../scripts/verify-store-artifact.mjs --platform=macos
scripts.package:goai:win:inner: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && node ../../scripts/verify-goai-assets.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:goai:mac:inner: pnpm run clean:package && pnpm run build && node ../../scripts/verify-goai-assets.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
